Young woman found dead in Indore rented room

A young woman, employed at a private bank in Indore, was found dead in her rented room. Her father had been unable to contact her for two days, prompting him to visit her residence. Upon arrival, he discovered her body, which showed signs of burns and injuries to the head. The circumstances surrounding her death are under investigation.
